caption_L1: Here a is a bar graph titled Health and fitness club membership in Africa and the Middle East in 2019 , by country (in 1,000s). The y-axis plots Members of health clubs in thousands using linear scale of range 0 to 2,000 while the x-axis plots Country with categorical scale from Bahrain to United Arab Emirates.
caption_L2L3: 7 out of the 11 countries presented had a Health and fitness club membership figure below 500. South Africa was the only country in 2019 to exceed 2,000 in health and fitness club memberships. Egypt and Saudi Arabia are the only two countries presented which gained between 1000 and 1500 health and fitness memberships in 2019. The United Arab Emirates is the only country that received between 500 and 1000 health and fitness club memberships in 2019.
